A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CDSegNet and the Conditional-Noise Framework. All 22 pages of each version, including appendix text, equations, tables, and figures, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original segmentation, classification, robustness, and ablation results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and reports revised and additional appendix results.

M1.justification: The CNF architecture, noise network, feature fusion, training losses, and single-step inference procedure are unchanged. The revised appendix scores are not accompanied by a reported method modification.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ScanNet, ScanNet200, nuScenes, ModelNet40, and ShapeNet with the same task and perturbation coverage. The additional ScanNet result uses an already represented benchmark and test split.

E2.justification: Appendix Table 5 adds PTv3+CNF to the ScanNet comparison alongside PonderV2, PTv3, and CDSegNet. PTv3+CNF already appeared in other comparisons; the remaining comparator sets are unchanged.

E3.justification: The stated splits, preprocessing, metrics, training budgets, model configurations, and noise levels are unchanged. No protocol revision is reported for the replacement scores or the added ScanNet comparison row.

E4.justification: Appendix Table 4 revises the evidence for CNF's transfer of noise robustness to PTv3 on ScanNet and ScanNet200, reporting stronger robustness at the larger noise levels. The tested conditions and other ablation, sensitivity, and supplementary analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for these results. The revision retains the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Appendix Table 4 changes PTv3+CNF mIoU from 77.4 to 77.7 on ScanNet and 35.5 to 35.9 on ScanNet200; robustness at tau=1.0 changes from 19.7 to 33.2 and 1.1 to 7.0, respectively. Other entries change too, including lower mAcc and allAcc for both datasets. Table 5 adds ScanNet validation/test mIoU of 77.7/73.9 and updates ScanNet200 validation mIoU to 35.9. Main-text results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, diffusion derivations, and arguments about inference iterations are retained. Correcting an equation cross-reference in Section 4.1 does not change the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning end-to-end segmentation, single-step inference, noise and sparsity robustness, and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, indoor-versus-outdoor interpretation, and appendix Section 6 limitations remain unchanged. Appendix Section 2.1 does not revise its general ScanNet performance-decrease interpretation to distinguish the updated mIoU and accuracy trends.

D1.justification: Architecture and training hyperparameters in appendix Tables 7 and 8, hardware and training-time disclosures, data-processing details, and code/checkpoint links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, bibliography, and positioning against prior segmentation and diffusion methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 corrects 'Conclution' to 'Conclusion' and changes the feature-augmentation cross-reference in Section 4.1 from Equation 8 to Equation 3. The prose and section sequence otherwise remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Appendix Table 5 gains a row, and several existing tables are relocated with associated text and equation reflow. The overlap between Section 2.2's closing text and the Section 3 heading on PDF page 13 is removed. Figure content is retained.

improvement.justification: The added ScanNet PTv3+CNF test comparison modestly improves comparative completeness, while the corrected equation reference and repaired appendix heading overlap improve readability. These are limited gains. The revised scores themselves do not establish better paper quality, and the unchanged indoor-performance discussion needs metric-specific qualification because ScanNet mIoU now favors PTv3+CNF while accuracy metrics remain lower.
